meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu – Unitary National Jurisdiction (International Company Tax-Exempt Regime)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid – English Common Law base with residual French Civil Law influence and customary (kastom) law overlay; the International Company regime under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] is administered under Common Law doctrine with civil-law interpretation principles available
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus, signed 2017, in force for Vanuatu 2020)
Vanuatu–China Bilateral Investment Treaty (signed 2006, entered into force 2007)
Vanuatu–United Kingdom Investment Promotion and Protection Agreement (signed 2003)
Tax Information Exchange Agreements (TIEAs) with Australia, New Zealand, Canada, Japan, Korea and multiple OECD/EU states
No comprehensive double-taxation agreement currently in force (zero corporate income tax regime)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 13 of 2017, as amended by Act No. 21 of 2019 and Act No. 12 of 2020; Financial Services Commission Act No. 27 of 2017; International Companies Act [Cap 222] as amended (Beneficial Ownership Register and Registered Agent obligations effective 2020–2021); Companies and International Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Regulations 2021; VFSC AML/CFT Rulebook (2019, as revised); FATF Recommendations 24 and 25 as implemented by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport issuing authority of the UBO's country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or regulated deposit-taking bank

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter confirming account standing and signatory authenticity

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency or corporate registry extract of any corporate shareholder owning 25% or more
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry of the shareholder entity's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Ultimate beneficial owner or authorised corporate shareholder signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or registered agent notarised attestation for expedited filing)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory initial and continuous real-time screening of all UBOs, directors, officers, and authorised signatories against: (i) UN Security Council Consolidated List; (ii) OFAC SDN and non-SDN lists; (iii) EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions Database; (iv) UK HMT sanctions list; (v) FATF Public Statement and jurisdictions under increased monitoring (grey list); and (vi) the VFSC AML/CFT Rulebook designated-person and adverse-media registers. PEP profiling covers domestic and foreign PEPs, family members and close associates, with Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) mandating source-of-wealth documentation and senior-management approval for any PEP trigger. Re-screening occurs annually and event-driven upon any material change to the register; all screening is benchmarked to a Medium_Risk_Enhanced tier for a voice-streaming social application monetised via Apple IAP and Google Play Billing.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – International Companies Registry; name search, clearance and reservation are filed via the VFSC e-Lodgement portal by a VFSC-licensed registered agent (no direct public self-filing is available for International Companies)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be rendered in Latin script (English or French alphabet). The name must conclude with an approved corporate suffix, including 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', 'Corp', 'Incorporated', 'Inc', 'Société Anonyme' or 'S.A.'. The Registrar rejects names identical or deceptively similar to any entry on the consolidated VFSC register, names implying Crown/government patronage, names that are undesirable or obscene, and names that suggest regulated financial activity without the corresponding VFSC licence. Non-Latin-script names require a certified translation into English or French plus a supplementary name-search certificate.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the VFSC issues a written refusal notice citing the statutory ground under section 11 of the International Companies Act [Cap 222]. The applicant's registered agent may lodge an administrative appeal within 21 calendar days of the refusal date, attaching: (a) a formal appeal letter, (b) the VFSC refusal notice, (c) a fresh name-search certificate, and (d) a statutory declaration distinguishing the proposed name from the conflicting registry entry. The VFSC must issue its appeal determination within 14 business days. If the appeal is denied, judicial review may be sought in the Supreme Court of Vanuatu within 30 days of the determination. An expedited fallback is to re-file a modified name with a new reservation fee, preserving the incorporation timetable.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office at the registered agent's physical address in Port Vila is fully permissible for this unlicensed International Company. The International Companies Act [Cap 222] requires only a registered office and registered agent in Vanuatu plus maintenance of statutory records at the agent's premises; no physical operational footprint in Vanuatu is mandated for a zero-licence digital business. Monetisation is offloaded to Apple IAP and Google Play Billing, so no Vanuatu payments, banking, or money-transmitter licence is engaged at the pre-incorporation stage.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk of unannounced physical on-site inspection is approximately 1–2% per annum for an unlicensed, statutorily tax-exempt International Company with no physical trading premises in Vanuatu. VFSC physical inspections are concentrated on licensed financial institutions (dealers in securities, banks, insurers, agents) and on targeted AML/CFT trigger events; the Medium_Risk_Enhanced tier for the voice-streaming app does not independently elevate inspection probability absent a PEP or sanctions alert.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] (Vanuatu), ss. 4-12 (incorporation procedure), s. 26 (registered office and registered agent), ss. 29-33 (directors and officers)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Registry of International Companies, Port Vila, Vanuatu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form IC-01 Application for Incorporation together with executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital or escrow account requirement; authorized share capital is set at the subscribers' election (commonly USD 1,000) with nominal ordinary shares issued at par; consideration may be satisfied in cash or global assets.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Memorandum and Articles of Association as lodged with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission be and are hereby approved, adopted and ratified, and the allotment of one hundred ordinary shares of USD 1.00 each to the initial subscriber be and is hereby confirmed. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the Company be fixed at the licensed registered agent's address in Port Vila, Vanuatu, and that such agent be and is hereby authorized to act as the Company's statutory agent for service of process. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the nominated individuals be and are hereby appointed as Director, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer respectively, each to hold office until earlier resignation, removal or successor appointment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Registry of International Companies (via licensed registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request with three preferred corporate names to the VFSC through the licensed registered agent; VFSC verifies absence of undesirable conflict with existing domestic and international companies; once cleared, the name is reserved for 30 days.
required_dossiers: Copy of each proposed subscriber's passport
Covering letter from the VFSC-licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is refused, resubmit up to two alternate names through the registered agent within 5 business days; no additional government fee is charged for the substituted name.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and execution of constitutional documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agent (acting as company incorporator)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent drafts the Memorandum and Articles of Association in accordance with the International Companies Act [Cap. 222], including registered office clause, share capital clause, and objects clause referencing interactive software and voice-streaming services; documents are executed by the subscribers and the first director.
required_dossiers: Consent to act as registered agent
Subscribers' proof of identity and address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Deficiencies in draft constitutional documents are corrected by the registered agent before lodgement; no regulatory query is anticipated at this procedural stage.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge Form IC-01 together with the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association, the registered agent's statutory declaration, and consents of first directors; filing may be made electronically through the VFSC-authorized portal or by physical lodgement at the registry counter in Port Vila.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Statutory declaration of the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC issues a deficiency query, respond via supplementary statutory declaration within 30 days; failure to cure results in rejection of the application and a fresh Form IC-01 must be lodged with a new fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Effect payment of the incorporation fee (approximately USD 300) plus first-year annual license fee by international wire transfer with a unique payment reference; the registered agent forwards the transfer confirmation to VFSC finance for receipting.
required_dossiers: Bank wire transfer or telex confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the payment reference is not matched, provide the SWIFT/MT103 transfer details to VFSC finance and obtain a reconciliation receipt within 3 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation with a unique registration number and enters the company in the International Companies Register; certified copies are transmitted to the registered agent for delivery to the incorporator.
required_dossiers: Receipt confirming payment of incorporation fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains a clerical error, file a rectification application under s. 13 of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]; re-issuance is typically completed within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry / licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the inaugural board meeting to adopt the first board resolution, ratify the registered office, confirm board and officer appointments, and adopt an AML/CFT compliance manual calibrated to the Medium-Risk Enhanced tier; maintain a confidential beneficial ownership register as required under the AML/CFT framework administered by VFSC.
required_dossiers: Minutes of the first board meeting
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Missing governance filings may be normalized within 60 days by submitting late notices to VFSC together with the applicable late-filing fee.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Department of Customs and Inland Revenue — Business Licence Division (conditionally applicable only if a physical presence or domestic revenue is established in Vanuatu)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Vanuatu Business Licence (Business Licence Act [Cap. 246]) — not required for a pure offshore International Company carrying on business wholly outside Vanuatu

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Energy, Environment and National Disaster Management
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — pure voice-streaming digital service with no physical manufacturing, no installed discharge point, and no land-disturbing activity; below the threshold of Schedule 2 of the Environmental Protection and Conservation Act [Cap. 283]
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable at formation; if future server hosting or office facilities are established, zero-discharge sanitary waste disposal and compliance with Vanuatu effluent and solid waste management standards will apply.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not mandated for an offshore International Company without physical premises in Vanuatu. If a Port Vila office is later opened, fire safety certification from Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Services, structural load clearance from the Public Works Department, and workplace health and safety compliance under the Employment Act [Cap. 160] will be required.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Authority (VRCA), Lini Highway, Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu; official web portal: https://www.vrca.vu. International Company incorporation and registry oversight: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Port Vila; https://www.vfsc.vu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate the International Company (IC) under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] through a VFSC-licensed registered agent; obtain the VFSC Certificate of Incorporation, Constitution, registered office certificate, and Certificate of Good Standing. Step 2: An IC is statutorily exempt from all Vanuatu income, capital gains, withholding, stamp, and indirect taxes; consequently, VRCA does not ordinarily issue a TIN or VAT registration number to an exempt IC, and the VFSC registration number is the de facto statutory identifier. Step 3: Should the IC propose to make a taxable supply in Vanuatu (an activity generally outside the permitted offshore purpose of an IC), the IC must file Form VAT-01 with VRCA, supported by the Certificate of Incorporation, Constitution, registered-agent consent, annual turnover projection, and proof of operational address; VRCA then issues a VAT/TIN number within approximately 7 to 14 business days. Step 4: All filings are made through the registered agent in Port Vila; no fully digital non-resident self-registration portal exists.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vanuatu has no US-style check-the-box election and no hybrid-mismatch or CFC election regime. The IC tax exemption is automatic, territorial, and non-elective: it applies only to offshore-sourced income and to transactions with non-residents. As an elective corporate-law matter, an IC may by special resolution approved by VFSC convert into, or redomicile as, a domestic company under the Companies Act [Cap 191], which immediately terminates the statutory tax-exempt status. Conversely, an eligible foreign company may elect to continue as an IC and thereby enter the exemption regime.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act [Cap 252]; Vanuatu does not operate a separate GST or sales-and-use tax system. The standard rate was increased from 12.5% to 15.0% effective 1 July 2024.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 5,000,000 of annual taxable turnover in Vanuatu (Value Added Tax Act [Cap 252]); voluntary registration is available below the threshold; an IC supplying only offshore digital services to foreign end-users sits outside the VAT net and is not registrable.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance mandate, continuous-transaction-control system, mandatory API e-invoicing, or digital stamping obligation is in force in Vanuatu. A VAT-registered supplier must issue standard paper or electronic tax invoices containing supplier name, VAT ID, invoice date, description, quantity, price, and applicable tax treatment; VAT returns and summary schedules may be filed electronically or on prescribed forms, but individual invoices are not cleared or pre-approved by VRCA.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under the Value Added Tax Act [Cap 252] and the VAT zero-rating rules, exported goods and exported services qualify for the 0% rate when the recipient is a non-resident of Vanuatu who is outside Vanuatu at the time of supply, and the services are not performed, used, or enjoyed in Vanuatu. For the Voice Streaming App business, subscription and in-app purchase revenues settled through Apple IAP and Google Play Billing are supplies effected through non-resident platform operators to foreign end-users; the services are performed and enjoyed entirely outside Vanuatu, and all consideration is settled in foreign currency. The supply therefore qualifies as an exported service, and in parallel the International Company is statutorily exempt from VAT, creating no registration, output tax, or customs interface in Vanuatu.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Customs Form 4A) lodged by a licensed Vanuatu customs agent
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing physical export from Vanuatu (for goods)
Inward Remittance Certificate or foreign-currency exchange receipt issued by a Vanuatu licensed commercial bank
Foreign-currency commercial invoice and packing list
For digital services: Apple App Store Connect and Google Play Console payout statements, non-resident IP and geolocation logs, executed service agreement, and store-level transaction reports
Counterparty non-residence declaration or equivalent documentary evidence where requested by VRCA
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: VRCA may audit zero-rating claims throughout the statutory record-retention period; a claim that lacks the required customs, payment, or foreign-receipt evidence is reassessed at the standard VAT rate of 15% with default interest, penalty tax, and potential revocation of the zero-rating facility. Knowingly false zero-rating declarations attract criminal fines and imprisonment for natural persons and directors under the VAT Act, and for an exempt IC, mischaracterization of local supplies as exports can trigger retroactive loss of IC tax-exempt status and full taxation.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), acting as the central bank and prudential regulator under the Vanuatu Banking Act [Cap. 68], the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 191], and the Financial Transactions Reporting Act [Cap. 255], together with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) for International Company registration and AML/CFT supervision. The RBV issues banking licences, oversees licensed commercial banks and clearing system settlement, and administers Vanuatu's exchange-control liberalisation in conformity with its IMF Article VIII obligations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vatu is fully convertible for both current and capital account transactions. Vanuatu maintains no system of mandatory prior exchange-control approval for foreign direct investment, capital injections, dividends, profits, interest, royalties, or liquidation proceeds payable to non-resident shareholders of a Vanuatu International Company (VU-IC). A VU-IC may lawfully hold and use USD, EUR, AUD, NZD, GBP and VUV accounts with RBV-licensed banks. Bank reporting of large transactions is purely for Financial Intelligence Unit statistics and AML/CTF supervision; it does not constitute exchange-control restriction. The only practical friction is the bank's own customer due diligence and source-of-funds verification.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory export-proceeds surrender requirement, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no timeline for converting export receipts into Vatu under Vanuatu law. A VU-IC engaged in the export of digital voice-streaming services may retain 100% of foreign-currency earnings indefinitely in an approved foreign-currency account. The sole documentary mandate is that the underlying export contracts, invoices and settlement records be available to the bank and the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit if a suspicious-transaction report is required. No RBV conversion or repatriation certificate is required.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Multi-Currency Account (USD/VUV/AUD) with SWIFT access
Operational and Settlement Account (VUV/USD) supporting local payroll and third-party wires
Capital Escrow Account (USD) and Treasury Facility for FX forwards and cross-currency deposits
Local VUV Operational Account only, with limited foreign-currency clearing

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: Low as a primary treasury rail; Medium only as an auxiliary payout connector where a licensed sponsor bank stands behind the EMI. Vanuatu has no dedicated electronic-money institution licensing framework, and offshore fintech EMIs are not regulated by the RBV or VFSC. Most responsible EMIs reject a VU-IC because the entity is tax-exempt, non-resident, and lacks audited local substance. A foreign EMI may be used solely as a downstream disburse-and-collect API with full reconciliation into a licensed Vanuatu commercial bank account, but not as the legal account repository for the VU-IC's share capital or operating liquidity. Any such EMI arrangement must be vetted for FATF grey-list alignment, sanctions screening, and beneficial-ownership transparency before implementation.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: At least one director or Ultimate Beneficial Owner must appear physically before the bank's compliance officer in Port Vila at account opening. Vanuatu banks do not accept full remote account opening for a non-resident International Company unless the individual already has an established relationship with that bank. A video-interview may supplement physical verification, but RBV guidance and standard enhanced due diligence require a signed physical-verification record, original passport certification, and in-person identity confirmation for the signatory director. The UBO can be verified remotely by a notary or embassy official only when the bank has a written internal policy permitting it; remote-only opening is otherwise the exception, not the rule.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Registration as a Tax-Exempt International Company (IC) with no significant physical operations in Vanuatu
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete corporate kit including Certificate of Incorporation, Memorandum and Articles of Association, Register of Directors and Members, current Certificate of Good Standing from VFSC, registered agent's letter under the International Companies Act, a board-resolution package evidencing that central administration and board minutes are being produced in Port Vila, a substance memorandum explaining the outsourcing of app hosting and payment APIs, and evidence of a physical registered office and local company secretary.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Voice-streaming revenue settled by Apple IAP and Google Play Billing gives rise to many low-value cross-border micropayments
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed Apple Developer and Google Play Console agreements; app-store payout statements matching monthly volumes; commercial explanation of the merchant-of-record structure; a treasury diagram showing that the VU-IC receives platform-mastered settlements rather than thousands of direct consumer wires; device-level transaction analytics; and a third-party review confirming that consumer KYC and refund controls have been embedded in the platform.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk source-of-funds profile from end-users located in weak AML enforcement jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A written AML/CFT programme adopted by the VU-IC, including user identification requirements before activation of a paid voice-streaming account; top-user KYC records; anti-fraud and multi-account-abuse controls; prohibition on non-source-of-funds lending in the app; transaction-monitoring exceptions; monthly payout reconciliation to bank statements; and an external compliance audit opinion if requested by the bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO chain involves a nominee shareholder, trust or foundation in an offshore jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A certified UBO declaration identifying each natural person with an ownership interest; trust deed or foundation instrument; nominee agreement showing that the nominee holds no beneficial interest; source-of-funds and source-of-wealth documentation for each UBO; passports, residential proofs, sanctions-list screening results; and a sworn legal statement by counsel confirming that no bearer shares exist.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity capital must be routed by SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's banking institution to the VU-IC's USD capital escrow account at an RBV-licensed Vanuatu bank. The wire narrative must explicitly state 'Share Capital Contribution — VU-IC — Share Subscription Agreement [reference/date]' so that the receiving bank can classify the transfer as direct investment equity and distinguish it from trading settlement. Pre-notification to the beneficiary bank is mandatory, and the opening compliance file must include: the board resolution authorising issuance of shares and opening of the bank account, the executed subscription agreement, the Company's register of members, source-of-funds confirmation from the remitting bank, and a shareholder-certified identification pack. Vanuatu imposes no exchange-control authorisation threshold and no minimum capital deposit verification for International Companies.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For operational trade settlements, the preferred clearing rail is the SWIFT MT103 single customer credit transfer; batch payroll and supplier payments are executed through host-to-host MT101 files and settled by the Vanuatu bank's correspondent banks in Australia, New Zealand or France. Commercial letters of credit under UCP600 are permissible for physical equipment acquisition (e.g. servers, VoIP hardware) but are not applicable to routine digital voice-streaming payments; for those, verified MT103 wires to licensors, hosting providers, legal counsel and technology contractors are sufficient. Apple IAP and Google Play Billing settlements arrive as MT103 or ACH-equivalent credits into the VU-IC's operational account, and the treasury function shall thereafter make onward MT103 payments to group service providers using clearly referenced purchase invoices. All outgoing wires must be covered by an underlying contractual invoice, and any settlement above the bank's threshold is subject to financial crime review rather than exchange-control permit.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Vanuatu commercial bank OTC FX forward contracts (USD/VUV, AUD/VUV, EUR/USD) with maturities of up to 12 months, priced on the bank's own treasury desk and subject to standard ISDA or master FX terms

Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) in VUV cleared in the Sydney, Singapore or London market, where the VU-IC is a properly documented party and all cash-settlement is made in USD outside Vanuatu
Cross-currency swaps (USD/VUV and USD/AUD) used solely for matching balance-sheet currency exposures and executed under a negotiated ISDA Credit Support Annexe
A multi-currency account structure (USD, EUR, GBP, AUD, NZD) and treasury netting policy to reduce the need for derivative coverage while retaining full convertibility benefits

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Confirmation Statement (annual return) with remittance of the annual government maintenance fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Registrar of International Companies, Port Vila
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the anniversary date of incorporation each year; VFSC applies a 30-day administrative grace period before late penalties accrue
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: VFSC imposes a late-payment penalty of approximately USD 85 (VT 10,000) per month or part-month of arrears; continued default for three months may trigger administrative strike-off of the International Company from the register, with assets vesting in the Government of Vanuatu and cessation of legal capacity

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: An International Company must appoint an auditor unless all members pass a unanimous resolution waiving the audit requirement; no revenue or asset thresholds apply. A VFSC-licensed entity engaged in regulated activity is mandatorily subject to independent audit regardless of size or transaction volume
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted for use by International Companies under the International Companies Act (Cap. 222); accounting records must be kept capable of disclosing a true and fair view of the company's financial position, but audited financial statements are not filed with the Registry unless the entity is licensed

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No separate public UBO filing exists for a standard International Company; however, the Annual Confirmation Statement must confirm any shareholding transfers completed during the year and verify the names of directors, significant shareholders and the registered agent. Transfers of shares must be recorded in the Register of Members and the updated register must be made available to the registered agent and to VFSC upon request
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 800 - 2,500 for a small non-licensed International Company; waived if a valid audit waiver resolution is adopted; USD 2,000 - 7,500 for a VFSC-licensed entity

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (International Company exemption under Section 174 of the International Companies Act [Cap 222])
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Comprehensive statutory exemption from corporate income tax, capital gains tax, dividend withholding tax, business licence tax, stamp duty and exchange control. No VAT (15%) applies to offshore digital exports of the voice-streaming app; VAT is chargeable only on Vanuatu-sourced taxable supplies. The IC may also elect for zero-rated status on any incidental local administrative services.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form ESR-01 — Economic Substance Annual Return, filed through the VFSC Connect online portal (https://www.vfsc.vu)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 6 months of the financial year-end; standard financial year aligned to 31 December unless the registered agent elects otherwise

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company registered number and registered name
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter VFSC registration number exactly as stated on the Certificate of Incorporation

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered agent details and contact address in Vanuatu
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Agent address must be a licensed VFSC registered office; a PO Box alone is insufficient
Select 'Intellectual Property Business' or 'Distribution and Service Centre' consistently with the substance narrative; cross-reference the audited financial statements

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross income derived from the relevant activity (VUV)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Declare worldwide app-store revenue in VUV at the prevailing annual average exchange rate; attach the underlying revenue report
If all CIGA are performed by offshore founders, the IC fails the substance test; disclose and evidence board meetings or decision-making actually conducted in Vanuatu

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Employees, physical premises and director residency
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide headcount engaged in Vanuatu (director, local compliance officer or part-time staff); lease agreement and council permits must be uploaded

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of compliance with Section 174 exemption and ESR regulations
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attest that no taxable activity is carried on with Vanuatu residents and that the required books and records are kept at the registered office

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: ESR Act penalties: initial fine up to VUV 5,000,000 plus VUV 500,000 per month of continuing default; VFSC may strike off the IC or prohibit the registered agent from acting.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form AR-01 — Annual Compliance Return and Exemption Self-Declaration, filed via VFSC Connect portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 6 months of the financial year-end, together with the annual VFSC maintenance fee

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the exact name in the certificate of incorporation; any trading as is not recognised

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office and registered agent confirmation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm agent engagement in writing for the current year; agent must hold a valid licence

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exemption declaration under Section 174 of the IC Act
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Tick 'Exempt' and state the nature of the offshore activity (voice-streaming mobile application) to preserve the zero-tax status
List every shareholder holding more than 10%; include passport data, proof of source of funds and the AML risk rating

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Calculation of the VFSC annual fee
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Fee is a function of authorised share capital; no corporate income tax computation is required at this stage

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing surcharge of 10% per month of the annual fee; persistent default triggers administrative strike-off under the International Companies Act and a director disqualification order.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form IT-01 — Vanuatu Income Tax Return (Income Tax Act [Cap 150])
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: No filing obligation; Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax on International Companies, and the tax authorities issue no assessment

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Write N/A — statutorily exempt under Section 174 of the IC Act

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Not applicable to a compliant IC; a failed substance test recharacterises the IC as a resident company and exposes it to the full corporate income tax liability plus penalties.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% (Vanuatu imposes no dividend withholding tax; distributions by an International Company are exempt from all taxes, including final withholding, under Section 174 of the International Companies Act [Cap 222])
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu maintains no comprehensive Double Taxation Agreements; it has signed Tax Information Exchange Agreements (TIEAs), notably with Australia and New Zealand. No treaty rate reduction is therefore available. Where a non-resident shareholder claims a foreign tax credit, the Vanuatu paying agent should issue a Certificate of Residency and an Exemption Certificate to the remittance beneficiary for informational and record-keeping purposes; the beneficiary must provide a valid TRC to its own tax authority.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate: 0% for both royalty and interest paid by an International Company to non-residents. Treaty rate: none applicable in the absence of a DTA. Payments for the use of the voice-streaming app software, user interfaces, trademarks and API technologies are grossed-up free of Vanuatu withholding tax; the offshore recipient retains the full amount.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Vanuatu domestic law does not prescribe Local File or Master File thresholds. However, under the Economic Substance (International Companies) Act 2019, every International Company deriving more than VUV 30,000,000 (approximately USD 250,000) in gross annual revenue from a relevant activity must prepare an ESR substance file, including intercompany agreements, transfer pricing analyses and audited financial records. The documentation must demonstrate that the arm's-length remuneration of offshore founders, licensors and sub-contractors is commensurate with the functions performed in Vanuatu.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Economic Substance (International Companies) Act 2019 and accompanying Regulations require Vanuatu International Companies carrying on a relevant activity to satisfy a 'managed and directed' test, which is fulfilled through: (1) board meetings held in Vanuatu at least twice per year, with a quorum physically present; (2) at least two local directors or qualified employees based at the registered office; (3) a physical office and filing systems located in Vanuatu; (4) records of strategic decisions made in Vanuatu; and (5) an annual ESR return confirming that core income-generating activities for the voice-streaming app are not merely outsourced shell operations. Pure holding or zero-tax structures without these attributes are deemed non-compliant and lose the tax exemption.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the voice-streaming app as a Vanuatu International Company with no employees, no premises, no local board minutes, while treating all Apple IAP and Google Play Billing revenue as fully exempt without submitting ESR filings, intercompany service agreements or arm's-length remuneration to offshore founders.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Recharacterisation of the IC as a resident company; imposition of corporate income tax on all historical profits; ESR fines up to VUV 5,000,000 plus VUV 500,000 per month until compliance; strike-off of the company; and publication on the VFSC non-compliant list.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held personally liable for the company's unpaid taxes and penalties through civil restitution; wilful evasion triggers disqualification orders, departure prohibition orders (travel bans), and criminal prosecution carrying custodial sentences.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining nominee directors and a registered agent only, absent any real economic activity in Vanuatu; failing to file Form ESR-01 for two consecutive years; and failing to maintain books and records at the registered office.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Compulsory deregistration under the International Companies Act; forfeiture of the annual fee; penalties of up to VUV 1,000,000 imposed jointly on the company and the registered agent; loss of preferential status for all contracting parties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face personal liability for outstanding fees and penalties, a five-year prohibition from acting as a director of any VFSC-regulated entity, and possible extradition from treaty partners where fraud is found.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Processing subscription payments through Apple IAP and Google Play Billing while failing to identify and verify beneficial owners, using the app's digital wallet as a conduit for fraud proceeds, cyber-crime payments, terrorist financing, or facilitating transactions for sanctioned persons without an internal AML/CFT programme.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Asset freezing orders issued by the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit; civil penalties up to VUV 10,000,000 under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 14 of 2017; criminal imprisonment of up to 12 years for money laundering and terrorist financing offences.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for repatriation of misappropriated assets, confiscation of personal assets, and imprisonment for predicate offences; non-resident directors are subject to Interpol red notices and removal of passive investor protections.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Marketing the Vanuatu exemption to Apple/Google to reduce withholding, while the actual place of effective management remains in a high-tax jurisdiction; failing to register for VAT or digital services tax in end-user markets; and concealing the true beneficial owner from the app store payment rails.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Denial of any treaty or exemption benefits, retroactive VAT levies at rates up to 21% in user jurisdictions, penalties equal to 100% of the unpaid foreign tax, and inclusion of the entity on public blacklists of shell arrangements.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Foreign revenue authorities may pierce the corporate veil where the IC is merely an instrumentality; directors face personal assessments in the effective-management jurisdiction, travel bans within the EU/OECD framework, and criminal liability for tax fraud.
